issue.title: package.json "module" field points to the CommonJS build
issue.body:
`package.json` has

```json
"main": "./dist/index.js",
"module": "./dist/index.js",
```

but tsup writes the ESM build to `dist/index.mjs`. Vite/Rollup pick `module`, get the CJS file, and tree-shaking doesn't work (whole lib is bundled, plus a `require` shim warning).

Expected `module` to point at `./dist/index.mjs` (and ideally an `exports` map). Seen with ctx-log 0.0.7, Vite 5.1, Node 20.11.

rationale: Real packaging defect; no runtime code sample needed (config snippet suffices).
